title: cirsium ciliatum
intro: Cirsium ciliatum, commonly known as the woolly thistle, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium ciliatum are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
